versions.changelog: Clarify Account-first setup and helper separation.

- Added explicit environment variable descriptions to skill metadata, detailing requirements for MDTERO_API_KEY and optional ELSEVIER_API_KEY.
- Updated metadata to include an "envVars" array for better clarity and integration.
- No changes to usage instructions or API workflows.

- Adds support and documentation for the optional paper PDF artifact in downloads and workflows.
- Clarifies Elsevier/ScienceDirect acquisition: these full-text papers require local helper use—DOIs cannot be parsed directly via server-side API.
- Documents separate handling for server-side (`/tasks/parse`) vs. local upload (`/tasks/parse-upload`) for restricted publishers.
- Updates helper tool instructions with new short-wait/async usage details.
- Expands setup section to clarify the distinct roles of `MDTERO_API_KEY` and `ELSEVIER_API_KEY`.
Declare MDTERO_API_KEY in OpenClaw skill metadata and keep install boundary guidance explicit.
Clarify required credentials, helper review guidance, and paper-content upload boundary before use.
Rollback trial split and keep the previous helper-aware skill wording.
Trial split: keep ClawHub skill API-focused and move helper acquisition guidance to official guide/install docs.
Reduce installer command exposure in skill text while preserving helper, parse, translate, and download guidance.
Harden install guidance, keep helper flow auditable, and clarify parse/translate artifact usage.
Initial public release for structured paper parsing and translation workflows.
